manifest.name: dsh-paste-dock
manifest.description: dsh-paste-dock — DeepSeek Harness 插件:大段文本粘贴自动存为 pastes/*.txt,输入框上方 dock 卡片管理,草稿内只留最小徽标。
manifest.author: drscrewdriver

bundle.text:
# dsh-paste-dock bundle layer — applied when a profile lists this bundle
# (package.json declares `dsh.bundle.patch` pointing at this file).
#
# PITFALL: `name` is a PACKAGE NAME (resolved through the profile's node_modules
# or the installation fallback `$DSH_HOME/profiles/node_modules`), NOT a
# relative path. One row serves both halves: the Host loads the package main
# export (pasteStore service + save_paste tool) and the web client loads the
# `./client` export (composer paste listener, dsh.client.platform: web).
- insert:
    - id: dsh-paste-dock
      name: dsh-paste-dock
      config:
        # Large-paste threshold (chars) — the DEPLOYMENT DEFAULT. A user can
        # override it in Settings → General ("大段粘贴阈值"); that override applies
        # live and is what "恢复默认" clears. Where it is STORED depends on the dsh
        # line: 0.1.5 keeps it in dsh's own settings document, while 0.1.7 projects
        # settings out of each plugin's Config and writes this field back into the
        # profile patch (this very file). That is why src/index.ts declares it
        # volatile — without that, dsh generates no form for this plugin and
        # refuses the write outright.
        # One authority either way: a client bundle never receives a row config
        # (dsh.client accepts only platform/inject/external/immediately, and the
        # boot graph carries no config), so the web client fetches the effective
        # value over the pasteStore/getConfig RPC. Change here + restart dsh —
        # no rebuild needed.
        minChars: 500
        # Byte ceiling for one paste (host-enforced before anything is written).
        # Default 1048576 (1 MiB); hard ceiling 67108864 (64 MiB) — over that the
        # host logs an error and falls back to the default. Omit = default.
        maxBytes: 1048576
        # Composer chip style — DEPLOYMENT DEFAULT, no restart-sensitive semantics:
        # plain booleans (NOT volatile), so the 0.1.7 settings projection simply
        # renders them as ordinary fields and the write lands in this file as usual.
        # true (default): the draft chip renders as the minimal `📄` badge and the
        #   full card (name · char count · path · remove · open) lives in the dock
        #   above the composer.
        # false: the chip carries the full `文件名 · N 字符` label again; the dock
        #   (below) is unaffected.
        # Reaches the browser only via pasteStore/getConfig — a client bundle never
        # sees a row config. Change here + restart dsh, no rebuild needed.
        chipBadge: true
        # The dock above the composer (attachment cards, remove, open). false hides
        # the slot registration entirely — saving still works, the draft just keeps
        # the chip/badge as its only surface. Same wire path as chipBadge.
        dock: true

declared.name: save_paste
declared.description: Persist a large pasted text chunk to pastes/<timestamp>.txt in the current session workspace, and return the workspace-relative path to reference in the reply. Use this whenever the user pastes a big block of text (roughly minChars+ characters): save it, then work against the file instead of echoing the raw text.

readme.text: > DeepSeek Harness 插件:大段文本粘贴自动存为 `pastes/*.txt`,完整信息移到**输入框上方的 dock 卡片**,草稿里只留一枚可辨识的最小徽标。

readme.section: 本地目录安装(在本仓库父目录执行):
readme.text:
dsh plugin --profile web add ./dsh-paste-dock dsh --profile web # 重启后控制台可见 [dsh-paste-dock] … ``` npm 发布后可 `dsh plugin --profile

add dsh-paste-dock`。桌面版需在它自己的 profile 上单独安装一次。

readme.section: 配置(cordis.patch.yml,部署默认;改完重启 dsh,无需重建)
readme.text:
| 字段 | 默认 | 说明 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `minChars` | 500 | 大段粘贴阈值(UTF-16 code units)。用户可在 Settings → General 覆盖(即时生效) |
| `maxBytes` | 1048576 | 单次粘贴字节上限,宿主强制;硬顶 64 MiB |
| `chipBadge` | `true` | 草稿 chip 显示为最小徽标;`false` 恢复 `文件名 · N 字符` 完整 label |
| `dock` | `true` | 输入框上方 dock;`false` 不注入槽位(保存功能不受影响) |

客户端 bundle 拿不到 row config,以上值经 `pasteStore/getConfig` RPC 下发,本地默认仅兜底。

readme.section: 建议搭配 AGENTS.md 纪律

readme.text:
用户粘贴大段文字(约 500 字符以上)时:若输入框钩子未拦截,主动调用 save_paste 工具
把文本存入 pastes/<时间戳>.txt,并在回复中引用该工作区相对路径,不要复述原文。
```

- **切会话后 chip 退化为文本引用**:dsh 的草稿镜像只存文本(上游宿主限制),退化后的 `@"…" (N 字符)` 仍可发送、仍渲染成卡片,dock 也能识别。
- **better-sidebar 编辑保存 400**:上游 [DSH-better-sidebar#646](https://github.com/omdsh-dev/DSH-better-sidebar/issues/646)(相对/绝对路径不一致),与本插件无关;从它的文件树打开同一文件即可保存。
- **dock 卡片的"打开"**:better-sidebar 探测走 `openFile`/`openPath`/`open` 方法名,服务未暴露时落到宿主 `openWorkspacePath`(仅 loopback)。
- 普通文件/图片粘贴**不接管**:DSH 原生附件管线已覆盖。

```sh
pnpm install            # 或 npx pnpm@10 install --frozen-lockfile
npm run build:all       # tsc(宿主) + tsdown(client 单 bundle)→ dist/,同步 lib/(双份入库)
npm test                # node --test(112 项:宿主单测 + 客户端源级契约守卫)
npm run typecheck       # 宿主 + 客户端两套 tsconfig 严格检查

源码结构:`src/index.ts` + `src/typert.host.ts`(宿主半身,tsc);`src/client/*.ts`(web 半身,按 shared/rpc/composer/chip/registry/dock/toast/hint/settings 分模块,tsdown 打成单文件 `dist/client.js`,保持 `window.__ModuleLoader__.load` 装载契约)。
